name: Backend + AI Engineer
target: Roles asking for both, where narrowing to one half would lose the match.

content.summary: Engineer who takes systems from architecture to production — applied AI, backend services and dual-cloud infrastructure. Owns the architecture, HLD/LLD and deployment design for five platforms now running in government production, including a multilingual assistant live on kheloindia.gov.in and a ~60,000-LOC drafting platform built solo, piloted in a live 2026 Parliament session. Equally at home designing a retrieval pipeline, tuning Postgres and connection pools under load, or writing the scope document that decides what gets built. National-level athlete and 7x hackathon placer.

experience.employer: EY  (deployed to National e-Governance Division, MeitY)
experience.context: AI, backend and platform engineering for Government of India digital services — Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, Sports Authority of India, and Ministry of Corporate Affairs.

blocks.title: Khelo India Knowledge Assistant — live in production on kheloindia.gov.in

bullets.text: Architected a citizen-facing multilingual RAG assistant — 206 documents / 11,611 chunks, 12 languages via Bhashini — with hybrid retrieval fusing pgvector ANN over chunks and 86,000 generated questions with pg_trgm lexical search via Reciprocal Rank Fusion; judged correctness 3.9 / 4 across a 213-case eval bank.

Built the async FastAPI service and worker behind it: Service Bus queue, Redis pub/sub token relay and SSE streaming, Redis in OSS cluster mode with a hash-tagged keyspace, two-layer caching and 14 runtime feature flags; cut run-rate ~60% (₹9.4L → ₹3.5L/month), 532 offline tests.

blocks.title: PQ-Bot — Parliamentary Question drafting platform · MYAS / Sports Authority of India

bullets.text: Sole engineer on a ~60,000-LOC AWS Bedrock platform piloted during the 2026 Parliament monsoon session — a 10-stage pipeline with semantic cache, LLM planner, verbatim answer-of-record reuse, reranking and recency blending with per-claim volatility half-lives, emitting per-sentence citations.

95 REST endpoints, 34 Postgres tables, 33 Alembic migrations; tuned concurrency for high fan-out (anyio worker limits, shared fan-out executor, 50-connection pool, explicit transaction release before long blocking calls) and hardened LLM-authored SQL with sqlglot AST validation. 312 tests green, SAST at zero critical findings.

blocks.title: MYAS Task Tracker & Khelo India Expenditure Tracker — internal platforms, in production

bullets.text: Authored the architecture, HLD/LLD and deployment design; re-platformed from EC2 + PM2 onto ECS Fargate (ARM64) + RDS Postgres 16 + ALB/WAF with a GitHub OIDC CI/CD pipeline holding no stored AWS keys and migrations run as a one-off in-VPC Fargate task that aborts the deploy on failure.
Built the Next.js 14 application layer — 26 Prisma models, 94 server actions, hierarchy-driven RBAC across 9 roles; the expenditure platform tracks ₹924 Cr across 14 regional centres.

blocks.title: PMIS — AI scoping, Prime Minister Internship Scheme · Ministry of Corporate Affairs

bullets.text: Authored the 12,000-word AI Scope Document and a 14-page Feasibility Assessment — consolidating 19 use cases into 8 features on 6 shared building blocks across a 144 person-month programme, phased behind five data gates.

blocks.title: Scout — internal bid discovery platform · EY

bullets.text: Built a Python crawler and classification service over public procurement portals (GeM, CPPP) — Playwright ingestion, a five-parameter weighted scoring model, 190 tests, 31 ADRs.
